 Judgement

This Civil Miscellaneous Appeal has been filed against the judgement and decree dated 27.07.2023
and made in Mact Op No. 782 of 2022 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Additional District Judge, Thiruvannamalai.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on: 04/07/2025 04:05:27 pm )
2. The brief facts of the case:
ON 18.03.2020 at about 10.00 a.m the deceased Renu was proceeding in a two wheeler, bearing registration No. TN 25 BL 9478 belonging to the third respondent ,
on the left extreme of the road, towards east on Tiruvannamalai to Tindivanam Road,
near Vaniyathangal Sudhagar Garden at that time the driver of the car bearing registration No. PY 01 CR 6696 belonging to the first respondent, drove the same in a rash and negligent manner, came behind and dashed the two wheeler.
Due to the said accident the deceased Renu sustained a injuries all over the body.
Immediately he was taken to the hospital and he died on 29.03.2020.

Thereafter,
claimants/appellants herein filed the petition before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Additional District Judge, Thiruvannamalai ( in short 'tribunal') claiming compensation of Rs.20,00,000/-.
After considering the oral and documentary evidence the tribunal awarded Rs.8,60,825/- as compensation.
Challenging the quantum of compensation claimants filed this appeal.

sentences.text:
3. The learned counsel for the claimants/appellants submit that the accident was happened in the year 2020 and deceased is agriculturist who https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
04/07/2025 04:05:27 pm ) earned Rs.15,000/- per month but the tribunal erroneously fixed Rs.12,000/- as monthly income which is very meagre.
Hence, the claimants filed this appeal to enhance the compensation.

4. The learned counsel for the contesting respondents submit that the deceased was aged about 65 years at the time of the accident and he has no other separate income hence the tribunal rightly fixed Rs.12,000/- as monthly income.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the deceased is aged about 65 years at the time of the accident and also considering the date of the accident monthly income fixed by the tribunal is meagre.
Hence this Court is inclined to enhance the monthly income to Rs.15,000/-.
Accordingly, the claimants are entitled to Rs.8,40,000/-.
Compensation awarded in other heads remain unchanged.

6. In view of the discussions made earlier, the award passed by the Tribunal is modified as follows:-
 S.N Head Compensation   o. awarded by   tribunal   1. Loss of Dependency Rs.7,56,000/- 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 04/07/2025 04:05:27 pm )
 S.N Head Compensation   o. awarded by   tribunal   2. Loss of love and affection Rs.44,000/- 
 3. Loss of Estate Rs.16,500/- 
 4. Funeral expenses Rs.27,825/-

7. The respondents/Insurance Company is directed to deposit the enhanced award amount of Rs.
Rs.9,28,325/- together with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum from the date of claim petition to the date of realisation, to the credit of MACT OP No. 782 of 2022 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Additional District Judge, Thiruvannamalai.
within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this judgment.
With the above directions, the Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is partly allowed.
